title: Employment Advisor/Paralegal
description:
As an Employment Advisor in our client's Liverpool team you'll be working on a caseload of respondent employment tribunal matters.

Client Details

Our client is a transatlantic law firm with offices in Liverpool. They are looking for an Employment Advisor/Paralegal to join their growing team dealing with respondent employment tribunal work.

Description

As an Employment Advisor/Paralegal your duties will include:
- Working in a collaborative way with colleagues in a strong legal team responsible for the management of employment tribunal claims for high profile clients.
- Managing your own busy employment tribunal case load from ACAS EC stage to resolution.
- Understanding client objectives and priorities in order to define the strategy for the resolution of claims.
- Liaising closely with client contacts to identify and obtain necessary case information.
- Assessing case documents to compile clear and comprehensive assessments of the merits of the defence to a claim.
- Leading on each stage of the litigation process, including preparing for preliminary hearings, compiling disclosure, drafting witness statements, and preparing for final hearing.
- Maintaining regular communication with the client, providing updates and advice at each stage of the process

Profile

A successful Employment Advisor/Paralegal should have at least 12 months experience of dealing with employment tribunal matters. Please note the level of experience identified in this advert is a guide only and does not preclude candidates with more or less experience from applying.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £33,000 to £45,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working arrangement for greater flexibility.
- Bonus scheme based on performance.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Enforcement Paralegal - Debt Recovery
description:
Enforcement Paralegal

Liverpool Permanent Full-time

Standard 8 is recruiting a Paralegal to join an established Enforcement team in Liverpool.

This is a practical litigation support role where you'll work alongside fee earners dealing with live enforcement matters. You won't spend your day watching from the sidelines. You'll be speaking with clients and other parties, preparing correspondence, helping with legal documents and keeping matters moving.

The team can consider candidates at different stages of their legal career, so previous paralegal experience isn't essential. What matters is that you're organised, comfortable dealing with people and capable of working accurately when there are deadlines to meet.

What you'll be doing
- You'll support fee earners with the day-to-day running of enforcement matters, including speaking with clients and third parties by telephone, drafting correspondence and assisting with the preparation of legal documents.
- As you develop, you'll be given more responsibility for drafting documents yourself.
- You'll also help manage incoming correspondence and email folders, respond to clients and other parties where appropriate and make sure tasks don't disappear because somebody assumed somebody else was dealing with them.
- It's a busy legal environment, so being able to organise your workload and communicate properly matters.

What we're looking for
- Some previous experience in a legal environment would be useful, but it isn't essential. The same applies to formal legal qualifications.
- You'll need strong written and verbal communication skills, a professional telephone manner and the confidence to deal with clients and other parties.
- You should be comfortable using Microsoft Office and generally competent with systems and technology. Previous experience of Proclaim or another case management system would be an advantage rather than a requirement.
- There is genuine scope to develop within the team for somebody who proves they can handle the work.

The firm also provides training and development and carries out annual remuneration reviews

title: Housing Disrepair Paralegal
description:
Housing Disrepair Paralegal

Progressive Civil Litigation specialist practice operating out of central Liverpool has a very exciting opening for an ambitious Paralegal to join its established Housing Disrepair team.

The position will see you focusing on a Housing Disrepair caseload from introduction of the claims right through to settlement. You'll be a confident Paralegal, experienced in handling your own caseload from instruction to settlement and also assist the senior team on complex litigated matters.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Paralegal to join a renowned, growing Housing Disrepair team at an exciting stage of its development. The reward for your role will be a competitive salary (in line with your previous experience) along with full company benefits.

title: Legal Assistant - MOJ Stage 3
description:

With offices in Liverpool and Bolton, we offer nationwide legal advice across a wide range of sectors.

Our areas of expertise include Credit Hire, Personal Injury, including Complex Injury, Clinical and Professional Negligence, Housing Disrepair, Group Action Claims and Public Inquiries. We are driven by a commitment to achieving successful outcomes, surpassing client expectations, and creating a supportive environment that empowers our employees to build fulfilling and rewarding careers.

We understand that our growth as a business is driven by the success of our people. We take pride in fostering a positive, collaborative work environment where everyone can contribute to our shared success. We are currently recruiting for an experienced Legal Assistant to join our MOJ Stage 3 team in Liverpool. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about the work they do, the service they provide and getting the best results for their clients.

As Legal Assistant on the MOJ team you will be responsible for progressing claims through Stage 3 of the MOJ portal in an accurate and efficient manner.

You will be working individually with a high attention to detail but also as part of the team. You will be dealing with admitted liability cases in the hope to settle quantum.

If you have got drive and determination, ambition and are looking for a stimulating career then we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities to include:

- Reviewing claimant's losses and vehicle related losses including Credit Hire
- Drafting witness statements in a timely and accurate manner
- Submitting court proceedings packs via the MOJ portal

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
